r_meaning.R1: CONNECTED: judge link up, no valid course yet
r_meaning.R2: COURSE_VALID: ready to declare (PREPARE goes to the vehicles, R3 when they ack)
r_meaning.R3: DECLARED: the judge has the declaration, heartbeats run; enable_auto next
r_meaning.R4: READY: every declared vehicle is in AUTO, waiting for RunStart
r_meaning.R5: RUNNING: RunStart verified, tasks may start
r_meaning.R6: ENDED: STOP_RUN sent; declare again or reset

v_meaning.BOOT: V0 mission manager up, no FCU heartbeat yet
v_meaning.KILLED: V1 kill / E-stop asserted: motors dead; release it, then confirm_safe -> MANUAL
v_meaning.MANUAL: V2 the mission manager commands nothing: usv_ui, the transmitter or nobody drives; enable_auto needs handover + arm + EKF + PREPARE
v_meaning.AUTO_HOLD: V3 the mission manager holds the FCU in HOLD, no task; start_task / goto from the OCS
v_meaning.AUTO_TASK: V4 a task behaviour drives (see the task stage); hold pauses, abort drops it, stop in usv_ui takes the FCU back
v_meaning.AUTO_SAFE_HOLD: V5 paused in HOLD by hold / a soft fault / a keep-out; resume continues the task
v_meaning.FAULT: V6 a hard fault (FCU_LOST, EKF_BAD, unexpected disarm): clear it, then confirm_safe -> MANUAL
v_meaning.OFFLINE: the mission manager's last will: it is down

usage.usage: declare                 RunDeclaration + PREPARE; R2/R4/R6 -> R3
enable_auto  (auto)     MANUAL -> AUTO_HOLD; needs armed, EKF, PREPARE
disable_auto            AUTO_HOLD -> MANUAL (abort a task first)
start_task [m4t0|goto|m0t0|m0t1|...][sim]   needs AUTO_HOLD + RunStart; no code = the preselected mission; old names (T4) work
goto --x N --y E [--speed V]   bench task: drive to local metres
hold                    AUTO_HOLD/AUTO_TASK -> AUTO_SAFE_HOLD (task kept)
resume                  AUTO_SAFE_HOLD -> back to the task or AUTO_HOLD
abort  (stop)           drop the task -> AUTO_HOLD
confirm_safe (confirm)  leave KILLED / FAULT after the input cleared -> MANUAL
end_run  (end)          STOP_RUN; R -> R6
reset                   both ends to the start: RESET to the vehicle (abort, manual, run forgotten), OCS -> R2
select_target red|green|blue   m0t4: the face to approach (the vehicle picks GREEN by itself)
save_point NAME [--lat LAT --lon LON]   the boat's fix (or that position) as NAME in points.json: m0t2 --names
del_point NAME          remove a saved point
clear_map               the boat's map forgets its detections (not while a task runs)
home [--speed V]        GO HOME: abort what runs, 0.3 m/s to the saved point HOME (else the origin), hold - any AUTO state
fcu_mode MODE            v0.1.50: the FCU's mode (MANUAL / HOLD / ...) through the mission manager; last wins
arm                     v0.1.50: ARM the FCU (its pre-arm checks decide)
disarm                  v0.1.50: DISARM the FCU
rc6_policy latched|hold  v0.1.50: RC6 latched = a later command wins; hold = no autonomy while RC6 is high
fence apply course|geofence | fence on|off   v0.1.53: the USV's FCU geofence (upload + read back; DO_FENCE_ENABLE; off by default)
tune [KEY VALUE | save]  v0.1.49: a mission-manager knob (MANUAL / AUTO_HOLD); save = usv_tuned.yaml on the boat
step                    advance the running m0t0 (TEST_MANUAL) one stage; m0t1: skip its timer
skip                    v0.1.68 free run only: end the current stage's behaviour now (the next stage)
session start NAME [--model --tape --path --aim10 --confirm aim --label] | stop | result   v0.1.69: dry buoys / dockface / windows / uavmap / cannon, wet collect - OCS-side, nothing moves
mission [m4t0|goto|m0t0|m0t1|off][sim] [--auto]   preselect what start_task runs; --auto = start it on RunStart; sim = fake FCU only
inject run_start|assistance|keep_out|all_clear|moving|confirm [--lat --lon --cseq N]
ready                   macro: declare + enable_auto + wait for RunStart
manual                  macro: abort if a task runs, then disable_auto
next                    what is allowed now and why not (into the log)
state                   the ocs/state line (into the log)
kill on|off             plant: assert / release the kill line (V1)
rc6 on|off              plant: RC6 MANUAL override (V2)
estop on|off            plant: RC5 motor E-stop (V1)
fcu pause [S]           plant: stop the MAVLink stream S s (default 4) -> FCU_LOST (V6)
ekf on|off              plant: EKF position ok flag (EKF_BAD -> V6)
armed on|off            plant: the transmitter arms / disarms (the fake's arm line; `arm` / `disarm` = MAVLink)
teleport LAT LON [HDG]  plant: move the boat
map                     open the browser map (tools/map.html) on the hub websocket; BOAT tab = text map
clear                   clear the log
help                    HELP screen (the playbook)
quit  (q)               leave the console; the bench keeps running (make stop stops it)
stop_reset              macro STOP & RESET: abort, disable_auto, fcu_mode HOLD, disarm, report off, reset

DECLARE.does: publish the RunDeclaration to the judge; PREPARE (+course) to every vehicle; heartbeats start
DECLARE.then: R3 DECLARED; the judge answers with RunStart (fake judge: after --start-delay) -> R5

ENABLE_AUTO.does: vehicle MANUAL -> AUTO_HOLD (HOLD mode on the FCU)
ENABLE_AUTO.needs: armed, EKF ok, PREPARE seen, no kill / RC override / fault
ENABLE_AUTO.then: V3 AUTO_HOLD; STATE_AUTO in the heartbeat; R3 -> R4 when every declared vehicle is in AUTO

DISABLE_AUTO.needs: no task running: abort first (ABORT_TASK) if in AUTO_TASK / SAFE_HOLD

START_TASK.does: start a mission by its code (m4t0 = T4 built; goto on the bench; m0t0 / m0t1 = no-motion test missions)
START_TASK.needs: a verified RunStart (run_id known to the vehicle)
START_TASK.then: V4 AUTO_TASK; m4t0 waits in LISTEN for an incident; m0t* start in S1
START_TASK.next: inject assistance (bench) or wait for the judge; step for m0t0
START_TASK.args: mission code m4t0 | goto | m0t0 | m0t1 | m1t1 m1t2 m3t1 m0t2 m0t3 (not built: rejected); +sim = fake FCU only; old names T4 / TEST_AUTO work

SELECT_TARGET.does: m0t4: override the vehicle's GREEN rule (the face colour to approach)
SELECT_TARGET.needs: BOX_INSPECT before ALIGN (PREFLIGHT .. ASK_OCS, or held)
SELECT_TARGET.then: the task approaches that colour's face (exactly one must be stable)
SELECT_TARGET.next: resume if held; watch the approach

SAVE_POINT.does: store a named point in the boat's points.json (usv_ui's file): the boat's own fix, or --lat/--lon (the map's drop point) - m0t2 / m0t3 use them by name (--names A,B)
SAVE_POINT.needs: a mission manager on the boat; no lat/lon = a 3D fix on the boat
SAVE_POINT.then: the point appears on the map and in MAIN's points list (overwrites a point of that name)

DELETE_POINT.does: remove a named point from the boat's points.json
DELETE_POINT.then: gone from the map and the list

HOME.does: the go-home override: abort whatever runs and drive slowly (0.3 m/s, GUIDED) to the saved point HOME (else the control origin), then stop and hold - with or without a run
HOME.needs: an AUTO state (in MANUAL the boat is yours: the transmitter)
HOME.then: AUTO_TASK RETURN_HOME GO -> DONE -> AUTO_HOLD at HOME
HOME.next: manual / disable_auto, or a new mission

FCU_MODE.does: v0.1.50: the FCU's mode from a page (MANUAL / HOLD / ...), as Mission Planner would - the FCU decides; with RC6 latched it also clears the latch (last wins)
FCU_MODE.then: the FCU's mode in the bar within a second

FCU_ARM.does: v0.1.50: ARM / DISARM the FCU from a page; its pre-arm checks decide (the transmitter's kill still wins)

FENCE_APPLY.does: v0.1.53: the USV's FCU geofence - the received course (RxCourse) or the OCS profile's geofence as one inclusion polygon (MAVLink fence upload, MISSION_ACK), read back and compared within 1e-6 deg; nothing is enabled by it
FENCE_APPLY.needs: not in AUTO_TASK; a received course (source course); a geofence inside the course
FENCE_APPLY.then: the ack: 'fence N points uploaded, read back identical' or the FCU's MAV_MISSION_* refusal; status fence.points_n / matches

FENCE_ENABLE.does: v0.1.53: MAV_CMD_DO_FENCE_ENABLE (a command with COMMAND_ACK, not the FENCE_ENABLE parameter); off by default - what a breach does is the FCU's FENCE_ACTION (apply_params.py preset)
FENCE_ENABLE.needs: on: a fence on the FCU (fence apply first), not in AUTO_TASK; off: always
FENCE_ENABLE.then: status fence.enabled from the FCU (SYS_STATUS geofence bit, else the ack)

STATION_KEEP.does: v0.1.81 (WP37): the autonomous station keep - hold = FCU HOLD (motors neutral, drifting), loiter = FCU LOITER (a real position hold: AUTO_HOLD and every stage that holds); the safe hold stays HOLD; kept across runs; default hold until the LOITER drift check on the water (Test Guide W1)

RC6.does: v0.1.50: the RC6 override's rule - latched: a later page command wins over a high RC6 (the next flip takes the boat back); hold: while RC6 is high, no autonomy

REPORT.does: v0.1.53: START / STOP REPORTING - the OCS's heartbeats for every vehicle to RoboCommand at 2 Hz before a declaration (the handbook: at all times in the course area); off = none now, whatever R (v0.1.54)
REPORT.then: the judge page's JUDGE RECEIVES shows our heartbeats

USV_READY.does: v0.1.82: the boat's PILOT READY - an OCS flag; with ocs.usv_heartbeat button DECLARE refuses the boat until ▶ HEARTBEAT USV (report on usv) and this; cleared by STOP / RESET
USV_READY.needs: report on usv (its heartbeat to RoboCommand)

DECLARE_UAV.does: v0.1.64 (WP14): the UAV (UAV1, drone SGIT-53577) in the next declaration - its FCU fence and FENCE_ALT_MAX, the pilot's call sign; off by default, m1t2 needs it on; kept across runs
DECLARE_UAV.needs: the UAV adapter up (launcher UAV on) for the declare itself
DECLARE_UAV.then: the next declare carries both vehicles

UAV.does: v0.1.64 (WP14): the UAV's words - ready on|off (the pilot said ready: the UAV's PREPARE can go DONE), task N|none (current_task by hand), resend_course (the cached course to the Orin again)

CLEAR_MAP.does: the boat's perception map forgets every detection (buoys, dock); the camera fills it again
CLEAR_MAP.needs: no task running (a task may steer by the map)
CLEAR_MAP.then: the map empties; fresh detections reappear within seconds

TUNE.does: v0.1.49: a mission-manager knob into the live config (the next task start reads it); `tune save` = a profile copy on the boat (logs/launch/<stamp>/usv_tuned.yaml) - never an FCU parameter
TUNE.needs: no task running (a task keeps the values it started with); a whitelisted key, its range
TUNE.then: the ack says old -> new; the boat window's TUNING card shows it
TUNE.next: start the task; tune save to keep it
TUNE.args: KEY VALUE | save (ocs_cli tune lists the knobs)

HOLD.does: pause: AUTO_HOLD / AUTO_TASK -> AUTO_SAFE_HOLD, task kept at its sub-state

RESUME.does: leave SAFE_HOLD: back to the paused task (AUTO_TASK) or to AUTO_HOLD
RESUME.needs: the hold cause cleared (no soft fault, no sticky hold)

SKIP.does: v0.1.68 (free run only): end the current stage's behaviour now - the task's own next event fires (SWAY_SEARCH ends its pass early); a stage that ends on the map / the UAV / a timer / a report is refused
SKIP.needs: the mission manager in free run (--free-run, the lab profile); a motion stage
SKIP.then: the next stage (with --step: parked before it)
SKIP.next: resume (with --step), or watch the next stage

SESSION.does: v0.1.69: a dry / wet session - OCS-side (the page server runs it): the observers and feeds for one stage, its METRICS on the MISSION tab, a result file in logs/ocs/sessions/; nothing moves, the FCU is not touched
SESSION.needs: bench / lab / pool profile (bench_mode or test_mode); on the course network only `collect`; the page server up
SESSION.then: ocs/state session.current with its metrics; `session stop` writes the result

ABORT_TASK.does: drop the task: AUTO_TASK / SAFE_HOLD -> AUTO_HOLD

CONFIRM_SAFE.does: operator confirmation to leave KILLED or FAULT -> MANUAL
CONFIRM_SAFE.needs: the input cleared first (kill released / FCU stream back / EKF ok)

END_RUN.does: STOP_RUN to every vehicle; run -> R6 ENDED; a running task is aborted
END_RUN.then: R6; nothing from this run is valid any more
END_RUN.next: declare for a new run, or reset

RESET_RUN.does: both ends back to the start: RESET to every vehicle (task aborted, auto off, run forgotten), OCS -> R2
RESET_RUN.needs: a vehicle in KILLED / FAULT stays there (confirm_safe)
RESET_RUN.then: R2 COURSE_VALID (R1 without a course); vehicle MANUAL

STEP.does: advance the running TEST_MANUAL task one stage (TEST_AUTO: skip the rest of its timer)
STEP.then: S1 -> S2 -> S3 -> DONE (back to AUTO_HOLD)

GOTO.does: bench-only task: drive the plant to a local point and stop
GOTO.needs: a verified RunStart; guards.allow_goto_task in the vehicle profile
GOTO.then: V4 AUTO_TASK (GOTO) until arrival, then V3

INJECT.does: bench-only: publish what the judge would (run_start, assistance, keep_out, all_clear, moving, confirm)
INJECT.needs: run_start: R3/R4 (declared); assistance / keep_out / all_clear / moving: vehicle in AUTO (V3-V5), assistance in V3 needs a run; confirm: T4 in WAIT_CONFIRM
INJECT.then: the same cmd/<v>/incident envelope the real chain sends, origin=bench
INJECT.args: run_start | assistance --lat --lon --cseq | keep_out | all_clear | moving | confirm --cseq | course

missions.title: Dynamic Incident Response
what: station-keep and listen; on the judge's AssistanceRequest: break off, ack, drive to the request
position, report readiness, hold until ReadinessConfirm. Core needs no perception (first task end-to-end).
missions.starts: start_task m4t0 (vehicle AUTO_HOLD, run R5); it then waits in LISTEN for the request
missions.ends: DONE after ReadinessConfirm -> AUTO_HOLD; abort -> AUTO_HOLD; hold pauses (the detour map survives)
missions.judge_in: AssistanceRequest, ReadinessConfirm (Adv: KeepOutZone, AllClear; Disr: MovingObjectAlert)
missions.note: Advanced: KeepOutZone -> ACK -> AVOID -> AllClear.  Disruptive: MovingObjectAlert -> STANDOFF >= 10 m (not built)

and RED to starboard, exit at the SOLID BLUE buoy (counter-clockwise circle). The boat's own camera finds the buoys.
missions.starts: start_task m1t1 [--planner simple|s6] (vehicle AUTO_HOLD, run R5); m1t1sim on the simulated pool first
missions.ends: DONE after CIRCLE_EXIT_CCW; abort -> AUTO_HOLD; a scan that finds nothing -> AUTO_SAFE_HOLD (resume scans again)

missions.note: v0.1.21 (ROADMAP WP2): two planners - simple (gate midpoints) and s6 (pathing_sim's Dubins leg); a gate only crossable with RED to port is refused

missions.title: SCOUT — buoy to buoy, colour-blind, logs the field (declared as Task 1)
what: v0.1.79 (WP35): forward until the first buoy locks, then the nearest unvisited buoy by path length (1.6 m off every mapped
object), a 3 m stand-off, 4 s to log it; a slow 360 scan only when the map runs dry, then the unswept lawnmower points; home at the end.
Colour-blind: every buoy logged with its position (logs/scout_<run>.jsonl); the drone's buoys are targets too.

what: the same S1 -> S2 -> S3 -> DONE on timers (step_s each, 5 s by default), nothing moves, no judge traffic.
Proves START_TASK, the stage events, TASK_DONE and both consoles' stage display without touching anything.
missions.starts: start_task m0t1 (vehicle AUTO_HOLD, run R5), or `mission m0t1 --auto` -> starts on RunStart
missions.ends: DONE after the third timer -> AUTO_HOLD; abort -> AUTO_HOLD; hold pauses the timer; step skips it

missions.title: path test (waypoints -> path -> follow)
what: the pool-trial path leg through the final architecture: a path of saved points (or one generated from the CV
map, `pathgen`) is followed by the mission manager's FollowPath behaviour; what usv_ui's `pathto` did by hand.
missions.starts: start_task m0t2 [--names EN,G1,..] (vehicle AUTO_HOLD, run R5); no names = the gates in the mission manager's map (the PoR course)
missions.ends: last point reached -> DONE -> AUTO_HOLD; abort -> AUTO_HOLD
missions.note: v0.1.21 (ROADMAP WP2); m0t2sim on world_por = the Proof of Readiness run in simulation

missions.title: sway test (dock line -> sway along it)
what: the pool-trial sway leg through the final architecture: sway along a line the CV dock mapper gives (or two saved
points) at a set range; what usv_ui's `swayto` did between waypoints. The first half of docking (m3t1).
missions.starts: start_task m0t3 [--names A,B] (vehicle AUTO_HOLD, run R5); no names = the dock line from the map at t3.standoff_m
missions.ends: end of the line -> DONE -> AUTO_HOLD; abort -> AUTO_HOLD

missions.title: box survey of the dock faces, GREEN chosen, 1 m approach
what: the students' box inspection (v0.1.27, ROADMAP WP8): find and geolocate the dock's front faces (3 points per face:
left / mid / right), choose the GREEN one (or --target-colour), align on its normal, revalidate, stop 1 m off it.
missions.starts: start_task m0t4sim --scan-x 35 --scan-y 8 [--target-colour red] (vehicle AUTO_HOLD, run R5; world_boxes.yaml for SIL)
missions.ends: stop distance reached -> DONE -> AUTO_HOLD; a hold (strafe limit, no target face, ALIGN timeout) -> AUTO_SAFE_HOLD, resume goes on; wrong colour at VALIDATE -> back away + abort

words.hold: intent hold → USV1's mission manager (cmd/usv) · ack within 5 s (else TIMED OUT) · AUTO_SAFE_HOLD, the task kept
words.resume: intent resume → USV1's mission manager (cmd/usv) · ack within 5 s (else TIMED OUT) · back to AUTO_TASK (with --step: the next stage)
words.abort: intent abort → USV1's mission manager (cmd/usv) · ack within 5 s (else TIMED OUT) · AUTO_HOLD, TASK_NONE
words.skip: intent skip → USV1's mission manager (cmd/usv) · ack within 5 s (else TIMED OUT) · free run only: the stage's behaviour ends
words.start_task: intent start_task → USV1's mission manager (cmd/usv) · ack within 5 s (else TIMED OUT) · AUTO_TASK (judged missions need R5)
words.mission: intent mission → ocs_app (the preselection) · accepted at once; no vehicle command
words.declare: intent declare → ocs_app → PREPARE to each vehicle, then the RunDeclaration to the judge · R3 when every PREPARE is DONE
words.enable_auto: intent enable_auto → USV1's mission manager (cmd/usv) · ack within 5 s (else TIMED OUT) · AUTO_HOLD (STATE_AUTO on the heartbeat)
words.disable_auto: intent disable_auto → USV1's mission manager (cmd/usv) · ack within 5 s (else TIMED OUT) · MANUAL
words.end_run: intent end_run → ocs_app → STOP_RUN to every vehicle · R6
words.reset: intent reset → ocs_app → RESET to every vehicle · R2
words.stop_reset: the STOP & RESET macro (■ STOP RUN): abort · disable_auto · fcu_mode HOLD · disarm · reset - each step's ack shown
words.fcu_mode: intent fcu_mode → USV1's mission manager (cmd/usv) · ack within 5 s (else TIMED OUT) → the FCU (DO_SET_MODE) · the FCU's COMMAND_ACK decides
words.arm: intent arm (asks first) → USV1's mission manager (cmd/usv) · ack within 5 s (else TIMED OUT) → the FCU · its pre-arm checks decide
words.disarm: intent disarm → USV1's mission manager (cmd/usv) · ack within 5 s (else TIMED OUT) → the FCU · COMMAND_ACK
words.report: intent report on|off → ocs_app · heartbeats to the judge start / stop at once
words.session: intent session → ocs_app (the guard) → the page server on ocs/session/cmd · its state on ocs/state.session
words.save_point: intent save_point → USV1's mission manager (cmd/usv) · ack within 5 s (else TIMED OUT) · the points store (usv_ui/points.json)
words.home: intent home → USV1's mission manager (cmd/usv) · ack within 5 s (else TIMED OUT) · RETURN_HOME, then AUTO_HOLD at HOME
words.declare uav: intent declare_uav → ocs_app · the next declaration carries the UAV

system.title: Reset the simulator (RESET SIM)
system.what: v0.1.33: the boat to the world's start, the mockups back to the file, every fault off, the mode switch HOLD, then abort, confirm_safe, reset on both ends, clear_map and the fake judge's counters (scripts/sim_reset.sh; the SIM page's RESET SIM… is the same). The stacks stay up

system.title: STOP EVERYTHING
system.what: every stack down in order: the boat (usv_ui quit first: outputs zeroed, the FCU as the transmitter left it), perception + camera, the judge console, rc-test, the bench / simulator, the OCS last (scripts/stop_all.sh)

system.title: RESET EVERYTHING
system.what: a clean start, the stacks stay up: RESET SIM when a simulator answers, else reset on both ends + the fake judge's counters (scripts/reset_all.sh)

system.title: Stop the bench
system.what: scripts/stop_bench.sh: every node of the laptop bench (brokers, fake FCU, mm, judge, op-tui)

system.title: Stop the fake CV (bench)
system.what: scripts/sim_world.sh off: no detections, the truth layer cleared

system.title: Stop the boat stack (NX)
system.what: scripts/stop_usv.sh over ssh: boat broker, usv_ui, the mission manager

system.title: Stop perception (AGX)
system.what: scripts/stop_agx.sh over ssh: cv_publish or the sim CV, the observers, the camera stream

system.title: Stop the OCS stack (this Mac)
system.what: scripts/stop_ocs.sh: hub, OCS app, judge, op-tui - and this page
